# Graphical lasso per cell type {#sec-glasso}

Estimate a sparse precision matrix $\boldsymbol{\Omega}_j$ for each cell
type $j$ with graphical lasso (`huge`), after gene-panel restriction.

Template: `scripts/03_01_grn_graphical_lasso.R`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# huge_fit <- huge::huge(x, method = "glasso")
# huge_sel <- huge::huge.select(huge_fit)
```
:::


Store $\boldsymbol{\Omega}_j$ and $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_j = \boldsymbol{\Omega}_j^{-1}$
under `data/processed/grn/` together with $\lambda$ and sparsity.
These matrices are the inputs to the contamination sweep
(@sec-sensitivity in the next chapters).
